summary.intent: Execute Phase 23 (rust-sdk-extraction) of the cipher-box project, extracting Rust crypto and domain logic into a Cargo workspace with separate crates.
summary.outcome: Wave 1 (23-01: Cargo workspace + cipherbox-crypto crate) completed successfully. Wave 2 (23-02: cipherbox-core, 23-03: cipherbox-api-client) was spawned in parallel but the transcript ends mid-execution.

repo: Project uses a GSD (get-shit-done) workflow system with wave-based parallel plan execution via subagents
The Rust crate extraction follows the pattern: cipherbox-crypto → cipherbox-core → cipherbox-api-client → cipherbox-fuse + cipherbox-sdk → desktop thin shell + CI
Desktop app previously had inline crypto primitives (AES-GCM, AES-CTR, ECIES, Ed25519, HKDF, IPNS name derivation) that are being extracted into crates/crypto/
workflow: GSD orchestrator clears stale _auto_chain_active flag on manual invocation to prevent unwanted auto-advance from previous --auto runs
Wave-based execution: each wave's output unlocks dependencies for the next wave — crypto crate must exist before core and api-client crates can depend on it
Spot-checks after each wave verify: commits present via git log grep, SUMMARY.md exists, key created files on disk, no '## Self-Check: FAILED' marker
Parallel agents within a wave each get a fresh 200k context window; orchestrator stays at ~10-15% context usage
